name: ii Menu Reborn
description:
ii Menu Reborn is the official comeback of ii's menu, one of the best known mod menus in Gorilla Tag. This is the real source repository, so it's the place to get genuine builds and report bugs.

- the original ii menu, rebuilt
- huge list of mods sorted into categories
- open source

description: iiPixel is a mod menu for Gorilla Tag built on ii's template, with a big set of movement, fun and visual mods you can switch on and off in game.

name: Nebula Mod Menu
description: Nebula is a mod menu for Gorilla Tag made by kman. The author says it's built for public lobbies, which means a high chance of getting banned if you use it there.

name: Blossom Mod Menu

name: Wolfz Pad

name: Xonncz Reborn

name: Breeze Menu
description: Breeze is an open source Gorilla Tag mod menu. Some antivirus programs flag it, so the author points people to the source code to check it themselves.

name: Singularity OS
description: Singularity OS is an open source mod menu for Gorilla Tag from GLXYMods.

name: Wizzy Client

name: Clouds Client

name: Ultimate Menu

name: Atlas Menu
description: Atlas Menu is a Gorilla Tag mod menu with its own Discord. Download the newest version, put it in your plugins folder and open the game.

name: Rexon Mod Menu

name: Rose Toy Mod Menu

name: EveCO Menu

description: Atmosphere's Dumb Menu is a mod menu for Gorilla Tag.

description: RYNX is a light Gorilla Tag mod menu, made while ii's menu was down.

name: Float
description: Float is a free Gorilla Tag cheat menu with overpowered mods.

name: Practice Mod
description:
Practice Mod lets you practice Gorilla Tag alone. It only works in private matches where you're the only one in the room.

- simulate being tagged and other practice tools
- needs Computer Interface and Utilla

name: Big And Small
description: Size yourself up and down, like in those jman videos. Pull the left trigger to grow and the right trigger to shrink. Only you can see the change.

name: Banana Fiend
description: Banana Fiend is a tycoon mod for Gorilla Tag from the maker of Seventy's Camera Settings.

name: Grapple Hook
description: A grappling hook for Gorilla Tag. Hold the right trigger to grapple.

name: Time Tab
description: Brings back the disabled TIME tab on the Gorilla Tag computer. Works with the normal computer and Computer Interface.

name: Packet
description: A networking library that lets Gorilla Tag mods send messages over WebSockets, without the risks of Photon RPCs or custom properties.

name: Potassium
description: An optimisation mod that tries to fix Gorilla Tag's stutters and lag spikes.

name: Gorilla Sounds
description: A simple music player. Load custom songs, shuffle, play, and swap the speaker songs for your own.

name: Focus
description: A slow motion mod. Hold B to slow down time, and change how slow it goes in BepInEx/config/slowmotion.cfg.

name: Maxwell On Locker
description: Puts Maxwell the cat on your locker. A small, silly first mod by NullVRGT.

name: Info Pages
description: Adds a screen to the computer that shows information about players in your room. Needs Computer Plus Plus.

name: FPS Booster
description: A mod that tries to boost your FPS in Gorilla Tag for smoother gameplay.

name: Monke RPC
description: A simple Discord Rich Presence plugin that shows what you're doing in Gorilla Tag on your Discord profile. The author has paused updates for now.

name: WASD Fly
description: Fly with WASD, no menu needed. Press F to turn it on and off.

name: Verity
description: Verity adds an AI robot that follows you around, listens to you and talks back. A public remake of the author's old private mod.

name: Ragdoll Mod
description: Ragdoll like in Garry's Mod. Click the right joystick in VR, or press B on PC, to go limp. Press P for settings.

name: Utilla Button Hider
description: Hides the extra buttons Utilla adds. Needs Utilla.

name: Are You Bored
description: A secret mod made out of boredom. Hold both triggers, both grips and all face buttons for 8 seconds to find out what it does.

name: Gorilla Time V2
description: A time changer with a PC window. Press T to open it and pick the time of day.

name: Join Private Lobby
description: Join a random private lobby using Utilla's join room feature.

name: Random Kick
description: A silly mod that sometimes kicks you out of your game while you play.

name: Which Map
description: Shows which map each player is in, right on the leaderboard, without lagging your game.

name: Gorilla Watch
description: Puts the hunt watch on your wrist in modded lobbies, filled with lots of mods you can use.

name: Bas
description: Turn small and big in modded lobbies. Needs the latest Utilla.

name: LibrePad
description: LibrePad is a free, open source info and utility tablet for Gorilla Tag, inspired by mods like EIOP and Sakuraa's Utility. Shows player info, and the author promises no backdoors.

name: Melontilla
description: A glue library so BepInEx mods that need Utilla can run with Gorilla Library instead.

name: Walk Simulator (original)
description: The original Walk Simulator by KyleTheScientist. Play Gorilla Tag with keyboard and mouse: walk, run, climb walls, swim, fly, and ride ziplines, ropes, gliders, broomsticks and hoverboards.

name: Minecraft Passthrough
description: Be your Gorilla Tag gorilla in a real Minecraft world, with both games running at the same time, using Fabric and the Essential mod to play with friends.

name: Clear Tag
description: Press the secondary button on your left controller to clear your tagged status and others'. This changes the game for other players, so expect a ban if you use it in public.

name: Forever Cosmetx
description: Unlocks every cosmetic locally, so only you can see them. Made by iiDk because many other Cosmetx "fixes" were broken or even had malware.

name: Fancy Nametags
description: Makes your nametag fancy. Needs BepInEx 5.

name: Day Night Manager
description: A little mod that lets you change the time of day in game.

name: FNAF Jumpscare
description: Has a 1 in 400 chance every second to play a Five Nights at Freddy's jumpscare while you play. Good luck.

name: Gravity Changer
description: Switch between zero, high and low gravity in modded lobbies. A for no gravity, X for high, Y for low.

name: Astra's PullMod Hub
description: A collection of classic, modern and experimental pull mod movement systems with customizable inputs. Pull mods are movement cheats, so they can get you banned in public lobbies.

name: Queuetilla
description: A library for making custom Gorilla Tag queues, working with or without Utilla.

name: Fortnite Emote Wheel
description: The emote wheel from Fortnite, ported to Gorilla Tag. Click the right joystick to open it. Forked from iiDk and fixed by DeezVr.

name: Code Joiner
description: Adds a code joiner panel on your screen. Type a room code and click Join, or click Last to rejoin.

name: Gorilla Map Teleporter
description: Quickly teleport to any map. Only works when you're not in a lobby or in a private modded lobby.

name: Gorilla Stats (Starry)
description: Shows stats about your gorilla in the top left corner of your screen.

name: Crash Tag
description: Crashes your own game when you get tagged. A challenge: don't get caught.

name: Gorilla Ad Blocker
description: Mutes all the video screens and adverts in the City map.

name: Second Look Skeleton Fix
description: Fixes FPS drops in private rooms when someone summons Lucy while you're on a different map.

name: Astra's NameTags V2
description: Shows player names, FPS, colors and a speaker icon when someone talks, above other players, with a clean look.

name: Gtag Clock
description: A lightweight mod that shows your real-world time in game, so you stay on time while you monkey around.

name: Gorilla Achievements
description: Earn achievements for hitting milestones, rare moments and difficult tasks in the game.

name: Action Monke
description: Places a little action figure of you on the computer table.

name: Hands Free
description: Lets your hands be free while you're in your SteamVR menu. SteamVR only.

name: Anti Lag
description: A mod that tries to fix lag in Gorilla Tag.

name: Bring Back Bug Babies
description: Brings back Doug the bug's babies, with full customizability.

name: Gorilla Music Pad
description: Adds a music player pad to the game. Import your songs and listen while you play.

name: Zero G
description: Zero gravity in modded lobbies. Made with Graicc's template.

name: Gorilla FOV Changer
description: An in-game control panel for switching between first, second and third person and adjusting your field of view. SteamVR.

name: Nachts FOV
description: A field of view changer for your Gorilla Tag camera.

name: Flooded
description: Flood the map with water. Turn it on from the Haunted menu or the computer.

name: PC Button Click
description: Click in-game buttons with your mouse.

name: Cat Clock
description: Places a cat clock in Stump. The author has moved to MelonLoader, so this version won't get updates.

name: WASD Fly (poopoovr)
description: Fly using WASD, and press K to turn flying on or off.

name: Monke Minimap
description: A minimap that shows the area around you and other players nearby.

name: Skeleton Mod
description: Makes the skeleton player model from the 2024 Halloween update show up all the time. Needs Banana OS.

name: Discord Notifs
description: Shows your Discord notifications inside the game. Open the game once with it installed to set it up.

name: Bubbles Room Joiner
description: A basic room joiner for quickly getting into rooms.

name: Pygmeii Camera Mod
description: A camera mod for Gorilla Tag, for recording and streaming with better views.

name: Minecraft Nametags
description: Minecraft-style nametags above players.

name: Megamind Nametags
description: Cool nametags that show info about players above their heads.

name: Subscribe Board
description: A fixed version of the classic subscribe board mod, for YouTubers.

name: Full Body Tracking
description: Adds full body tracking to Gorilla Tag on PC.

name: Random Sound
description: Plays a random sound every 9 to 30 seconds while you play.

name: Rig Cloner
description: Duplicate your gorilla client side to make cool and unique things. Pull the left trigger to make a clone.

name: Gorilla Legs
description: Gives your arms and hands a fun, leg-like look.

name: Jetpack Monke
description: Gives you a jetpack. Needs BepInEx 5.

name: Is This A Loop
description: Records your movements and creates physical clones of your gorilla that follow your exact past path.

name: Blossom Killer
description: Gets rid of the cherry blossoms and leaves in the forest.

name: Utility Board
description: A free client-side utility board for PC VR. Pop it open, tweak your session and close it.

name: Ranked GTAG
description: Counts your points when you tag people and survive in infection.

name: Bingus Nametags++
description: A simple, clean and customizable nametag mod.

name: Pass Through Leaderboard
description: Makes the scoreboard invisible.

name: No Leaves
description: Removes the leaves in Gorilla Tag. Put NoLeaves.dll in BepInEx/plugins.

name: Bible Verse MOTD
description: Replaces the stump message of the day with a random Bible verse. Client side.

name: Astra's Velocity Meter
description: A lightweight speedometer that shows how fast you're moving.

name: Code Saver
description: Join and save room codes on the computer. Works with the normal computer and Computer Interface.

name: Megamind Media
description: A simple media player that shows and controls what's playing on your computer.

name: No More Tracking
description: Press Option 3 on the Room tab of the computer to join a random six-character room, so you're harder to follow around.

name: Gorilla Tag Debugger
description: Shows all the information mod makers need while building a Gorilla Tag mod.

name: Computer Interface (fixed)
description: Toni Macaroni's Computer Interface, fixed by Fortyy to work with the current Gorilla Tag (Unity 6). Use this if the original no longer loads.

name: Sentinel
description: An open source mod checker that shows which mods other players are using.

name: Pepsi Dee Mod Checker
description: A mod checker that shows which mods other players in your room are running.

name: V1nneBoard Checker
description: A mod checker with a 3D hand menu and a laser scanner. The author says it was made mostly with AI, can be glitchy, and gives false positives.

name: Axiom Utils
description: A mod checker and utility pad for Gorilla Tag.

name: Chillinz Tagz
description: Nametags that show each player's name and platform, even from far away.

name: Twilight's Pull Mod
description: A movement mod that adds a pull mechanic to boost your movement. Pull mods can get you banned in public lobbies.

name: Original Player Model
description: Replaces the current gorilla model with the original 2022 model for everyone in your lobby, on your screen.

name: ComputerLib
description: A tiny library that lets mod makers add custom pages to the Gorilla Tag computer.

name: Vexar Cosmetics
description: Try on cosmetics locally to preview how they look on your gorilla. Client side.

name: Bible Browser
description: A Bible reader in game, with a daily verse and all 66 books to browse.

name: Forever Silence
description: Mute people for good. For when someone is screaming or breathing into their mic like a jet engine.

name: Monke Phone (Green)
description: Adds a virtual phone to your hand with quick access to handy features.

name: Body Tracking for SteamVR
description: Brings Gorilla Tag's body tracking to the Steam version using SteamVR trackers, so your gorilla's torso turns with you.

name: Gorilla Media
description: See and control any media playing on your computer, right in game.

name: Broken Leaderboard
description: A silly mod that breaks the look of the leaderboard.

name: Room Info GUI
description: Adds a window with the player list and info about your current room, including who is on Steam.

name: Magmarena Restored
description: Brings back the old Magmarena through the entrance in the forest. Private rooms only, including modded private rooms.

name: Gorilla Speed Boost
description: A customizable speed boost to move around the map faster.

name: Gorilla Wall Walk
description: Walk across walls to explore the map in new ways.

name: Bubbles Camera
description: A camera mod made for clips, with smooth first and third person, spectate, handheld and free cam modes on your monitor.

name: GorillaCraft
description: Your Minecraft world becomes a climbable Gorilla Tag map, with hand mining and building, in VR.

name: MonkeTV 2026
description: Adds a working networked TV to Stump. Play your own MP4 videos and watch them with friends.

name: TikTok Bubbles
description: Your TikTok live chat floats in front of you as bubbles in VR. Touch them to pop them. Private and modded lobbies only.

name: GTag PC Mode
description: Play with keyboard and mouse, with an on-screen menu to switch between PC and headset mode, plus fly and a speed boost.

name: Knife Holdable
description: Adds the terrorist knife from Counter-Strike 2 as a holdable cosmetic.

name: Argon Weather
description: Change the time of day and make it rain from an in-game VR menu. Built on the Argon menu.

name: Gorilla NextBots
description: Garry's Mod-style nextbots and ragdolls. Spawn nextbots that hunt your friends; when one catches you, you go flying.

name: Disable Ambience
description: Turns off wind, weather and other ambient sounds and effects. Handy for videos. In beta.

name: Platform Tag
description: Shows a STEAM or OCULUS label above each player.

name: Offline Friend Names
description: Fixes Gorilla Tag hiding your offline friends' names.

name: Instel's Notifications
description: A library that lets other mods show notifications to the player.

name: Bubbl Notifications
description: A notification library mod makers can use to show messages in game.

name: RGB Monke
description: Makes your gorilla cycle through RGB colors. Client side, so only you see it.

name: Liam's Casting Mod
description: A casting mod. Press H to show or hide its window.

name: Instel's Camera
description: A camera mod with most of what the built-in live camera has, but with more freedom. Push both joysticks up to open it.

name: Paintball Gun
description: Change the color, texture and material of objects around the map. Uses Banana OS.

name: Night No Rain
description: Forces night time with no rain.

name: Jetpack
description: A simple jetpack that boosts you upward using your controllers, pushing you the way your head is facing.

name: Gorilla Invulnerability
description: Stops the game's overlay behaviour and AFK disconnects from kicking in.

name: Gorilla Phone (hex)
description: A real phone in the world: grab it, throw it, take photos and selfies, and look through them in a gallery. PC VR.

name: Monke Game Modes
description: A collection of custom gamemodes like Team Infection, each as its own mod.

name: Backflip Mod
description: Be cooler than the rest of the monkes and backflip. Drag BackflipMod.dll into your plugins folder.

name: Hoverboards Anywhere
description: Use the hoverboard anywhere in modded lobbies.

name: ZyraCam
description: A free, open source camera mod for PC with customizable controls and a physical camera.

name: Gorilla Time GUI
description: Switch between night, evening, day and morning, and optionally add snow.

name: Monke Mirror
description: Adds a mirror to Stump so you can check out your gorilla.

name: Gorilla Dash
description: Press A on your right controller to dash in the direction your hand is pointing.

name: Mini Mod
description: Makes you tiny in modded lobbies.

name: Monke Watch
description: A PC VR port of the popular old Quest mod MonkeComputer, as a watch on your wrist.
